text: DSH Message Annotator 是面向 DSH Web 聊天界面的批注插件。它在 assistant 回复操作栏加入批注入口，并在聊天选中文本时显示浮动入口；批注会暂存在输入框上方的 dock 中。你可以为引用添加说明、编辑或移除单条批注，也可以把当前草稿和多条编号批注按引用逐项对齐后插入草稿或合并发送。适合需要针对 agent 回复提出逐段修改意见的用户。插件不声明额外 API 密钥或外部服务；未发送的批注保存在当前页面会话状态中。

DSH Message Annotator adds quote-and-comment notes to DSH Web chat. Select text or use an assistant-message action to stage a note with its quote. Edit or remove notes in the dock, then insert the draft with annotations aligned to quotes or send them together. Unsent notes stay in page memory.
我想引用回复中的几句话，再逐条写修改意见。
能不能把多条引用和批注整理到一条消息里发给 agent？
让 DSH 可以对聊天选中的文字添加评论。
回复太长时，我想只针对某一段提出问题。
我能先把针对回答的意见排好，检查后再放进输入框吗？
如何给一整条 assistant 回复写批注，而不是选中片段？
I want to attach separate comments to quoted parts of an assistant reply.
Can I combine my draft with several quote-aligned notes in one message?
DSH Message Annotator 的功能「选区批注」：在聊天中选中文本后，可通过浮动按钮打开编辑器，填写说明并将所选内容作为引用暂存。
DSH Message Annotator 的功能「回复批注入口」：assistant 消息操作栏提供按钮；打开编辑器时读取选区，无选区时可针对整条回复添加说明。
DSH Message Annotator 的功能「对齐合并发送」：dock 可编辑、移除或清空暂存项，并把草稿与编号引用批注合成一条文本；用户可插入草稿或提交发送。
DSH Message Annotator 使用前须知：暂存批注只保存在页面内存状态，刷新页面会清除未发送的内容；已发送消息不受影响（见 src/client/controller.ts:42-45）。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-annotator README · dsh-message-annotator：Select any text in the chat — an assistant reply, a mid-turn step, a tool output — and a floating **Annotate** button appears beside the selection. Each annotation pairs the quoted passage with your note and is staged as a numbered card above the composer: aligned, editable, removable. Send them all at once: the plugin composes your draft plus every annotation into one structured message for the agent.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-annotator README · Features：- **Selection floating trigger** — select any text in the chat flow and an Annotate chip pops up next to it; the quote is the selected passage.
- **Per-message action** — every finalized assistant message also gets an Annotate icon in its action row (next to like/dislike); without a selection it annotates the whole message.
- **Annotation dock above the composer** — numbered cards (`Annotation 1`, `Annotation 2`, …) each pairing the quote with an editable note; per-card remove, clear all.
- **Collapsible strip** — many annotations collapse into a single chip row (hover a chip to preview, click × to remove), with Send still one click away.
- **Aligned send** — `Send annotations` composes the draft plus all annotations into one message, each quote block aligned with its note; `Insert into draft` only stages the composed text for your review.
- Bilingual UI (zh/en follows the shell locale), theme-token styling (fits light/dark and glass themes).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-annotator README · Install：Declares the official `dsh.bundle` manifest — one command installs and enables it:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Theoz001/dsh-message-annotator
```

Then restart dsh and reload the Web UI.

Manual install (macOS/Linux):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Theoz001/dsh-message-annotator
ln -s "$PWD/dsh-message-annotator" ~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-annotator
```

then append to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-annotator README · Install：```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-annotator
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-annotator'
```

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-annotator README · Build：The repo ships prebuilt `lib/` artifacts; rebuilding needs only node + esbuild
(see `build.mjs` for how esbuild is located, or set `DSH_ESBUILD`):

```sh
node build.mjs
```

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-annotator README · How it works：Pure client plugin (no host changes): the per-message entry registers into
`conversation.chat.assistant-actions`, the dock into `conversation.input.dock`,
and both share one per-session controller; the floating trigger is a
document-level selection watcher. Sending rides the public input machine
(`inputActions.setDraft` + `submit`).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-annotator README · Known limitations：- The action-row button appears only on each turn's closing message (a slot constraint); use the selection trigger for mid-turn steps.
- Staged annotations are in-memory per session — a page reload drops them (sent messages are unaffected).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-annotator README · 中文说明：在 DeepSeek Harness Web 聊天界面里对 Agent 的回复划重点、写批注：批注以卡片形式暂存在输入框上方、逐条与引用对齐，随后一键合并发送给 Agent。交互参考 Codex 桌面版的 quote-and-comment 模式。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-annotator README · 功能：- **划词浮动批注**：聊天流里选中任意文字（Agent 回复、中间步骤、工具输出均可），选区旁浮出蓝色「批注」按钮，点击弹编辑框，引用即选中文本。
- **逐消息批注入口**：每条已完成的 Agent 回复的操作条（复制/点赞那一行）上也有「批注」按钮；不划词时批注整条回复。
- **批注条**：输入框上方列出全部暂存批注——编号、引用原文、可编辑批注内容、单条移除、一键清空。
- **缩略模式**：批注多时可「收起」为一行 chip（悬停看内容、× 单删），发送按钮保留，点标题处展开。
- **合并发送**：「发送批注」把当前草稿 + 编号对齐的批注块合成一条消息发出；「插入草稿」只排版进输入框供检查。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-annotator README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Theoz001/dsh-message-annotator
```

重启 dsh、刷新 Web UI 即生效。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-annotator README · 已知限制：- 操作条按钮只出现在每个 turn 的收尾消息上（插槽固有约束）；批注中间步骤请用划词浮动按钮。
- 暂存批注为会话内内存态，刷新页面即丢失（已发送内容不受影响）。
